title: 数据落盘与加载：assets/points.json 契约 v2

searched.q: MDN link rel preload as fetch crossorigin anonymous must match fetch credentials
searched.takeaway: as=fetch requires crossorigin. anonymous/omit credentials must match fetch() or the preload is discarded. Handbook: preload assets/points.json + fetch with credentials:omit, mode:cors.
encodedBodySize is the payload before removing content-codings (gzip on the wire). decodedBodySize is after. transferSize 0 on the fetch entry usually means the preload/cache was reused.

interface.points: [[x, y, i], ...] x,y in 0..1; i palette index
interface.placeholder: same keys; id=placeholder-random if fetch/parse fails
